text:
What is it, Kunon?
Previously, I asked you
about the emotion
known as happiness.
What must I do,
and how, to make
someone feel happy?
Well, um...
Is this, too,
a strange question?
No, I don't
think so, but...
It's just that this
depends entirely on
the person and the situation.
There isn't an absolute answer
of the kind
you're looking for, Kunon.
No, it's not
a strange question...
It's just that this
depends entirely on
the person and the situation.
There isn't an absolute answer
of the kind
you're looking for, Kunon.
I see.
...
The person you want
to make happy, Kunon,
is Ardylia, isn't it?
The person you want
to make happy, Kunon,
is Ardylia, isn't it?
How did
you know!?
It's nothing to be surprised about.
Anyone who watches you
can see that.
It's nothing to be surprised about.
Knowing you, Kunon,
it seemed a fair guess...
So it is
apparent...
What made you
feel that way?
Something must have
prompted it, right?
But what made you
feel that way?
Something must have
prompted it, right?
Well...
I believe it is probably
because you all arrived.
Huh?
In the past, Lady Ardylia
never willingly
interacted with people
from the other settlements
unless it was necessary
to fulfill her duties as Guardian.
But since she began accompanying
you and speaking
with so many people,
Lady Ardylia
has shown a variety of expressions
I had never seen before.
And I finally
came to realize
that this is
Lady Ardylia's
true self.
Her behavior before
was the unnatural one.
...
...
Among our companions in Latrix,
I am virtually the only one
with advanced conversational functions.
